tableLines.line: Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
👂 Overheard — Sam (to Gertrude): "Nina's story has a fresh coat of paint." Sam taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get a mechanic. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Deshawn.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Alba.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 2 people, 31 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)

Fresh-cut stems on the southwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table II's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The southwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table II isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
A mother from The Red Table II pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.

scaleLines.line: 📣 Anna stood down Night Court and kept walking. 1 rounds.
🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Redactor, Static, Night Court) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

🚨 The Redactor, Static, Night Court is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Nina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at on
⚔️ Nina killed the Night Court with their party — 2 rounds, 5 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.

Girma leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Night Court. Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
On the carcass nearby, Night Court (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.
